headline: CFTC Staff Advisory Clears Crypto for Clearing Reserves, Not Liquidity
summary: US Commodity Futures Trading Commission staff issued an advisory clarifying that select cryptocurrency assets can count toward reserve buffers at trading platforms and clearinghouses, but cannot fulfill liquidity rules.
why: CFTC guidance shapes regulatory compliance standards and collateral management for derivatives clearing organizations handling digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: CFTC advisory explicitly limits cryptocurrency qualification to reserve holdings rather than liquid reserves.
